$doc: Vyomi capability registry — API Gateway (apigateway.googleapis.com v1). See kms.json for the contract.

gcp.apigateway.apis-configs-gateways.title: API Gateway API (apis, API configs from OpenAPI 2.0, gateways)
limitations: Real control plane: API configs are validated like the real service (swagger 2.0, info.title, paths, an operationId and an https x-google-backend address per operation, duplicate operationIds, base64 document contents), a config served by a gateway can't be deleted, an API with configs can't be deleted, gateways must point at an existing config and get a {id}-{hash}.{region code}.gateway.dev hostname. Every mutation is a long-running operation that is already done.

Real data plane on the shared gateway engine (core/gcp_apigateway_gateway.py over core/apigatewayv2_gateway.py): a request to https://{id}-{hash}.{code}.gateway.dev/... (or the simulator origin's /gcpgw/{gatewayId}/...) is routed by the config's paths and forwarded to the operation's x-google-backend address (CONSTANT_ADDRESS / APPEND_PATH_TO_ADDRESS) with real HTTP. apiKey security is enforced against API Keys created through the API Keys v2 API (400 invalid key / 401 missing key), oauth2/JWT security checks iss, aud (x-google-audiences), exp/nbf and the RS256 signature against x-google-jwks_uri (fails closed when no verifier or no cryptography is available), and x-google-quota metricCosts are enforced against x-google-management quota limits (fixed 1-second / 1-minute windows per project, 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED).

Nano (browser tab) has no outbound network: routing, auth failures and quota still answer, but a forwarded call answers 503 UNAVAILABLE until the tunnel/booster path is wired. Not modelled: Service Management / Service Control activation, per-user quota dimensions, ESPv2 JWT claim-to-header, Firebase auth, CORS config (the backend answers OPTIONS), request/response transformation, gRPC, and real *.gateway.dev DNS/TLS (use the Host header or /gcpgw/).
